footer: This agreement contains 29 sections. You may go directly to any section by selecting the appropriate link provided. The headings are for reference only. Some capitalised terms have specific definitions in section 3. Underlined words in this agreement contain hyperlinks to further information. In those cases, your money will be held in accordance with the regulations and licenses applicable to such entity.
about-1: A fintech dashboard template built on web standards and native HTML, which makes it fully accessible, and compliant. The page consists of sensible landmarks like "aside", "header", "nav" and "main", which help screen readers describe it properly. It uses CSS for styling, animation, and unbreakable layout. A minimal amount of JavaScript is used for enhancement.
about-2: The menu supports both "a" and "button" elements as navigation items. On menu shrink, the logo transitions smoothly to an initial letter version. Its dimensions are defined by the theme, which also specifies the accent colour and supports dark mode. The user profile pop-up uses the standard "details" element for native disclosure functionality. The dynamic translation uses a JSON file as dictionary and data attributes as bridge between the app and the UI.
about-3: This template achieves perfect score in the most important performance/accessibility benchmarks like Lighthouse, Wave and axe®.

faq-a3: In local demo mode, passwords are hashed with a per-user salt. For production, use a real auth provider.
faq-a4: The exchange view is demo-only, but the UI is designed to support multiple balances.
